name: Aldabra Atoll
subtitle: A natural property on the UNESCO World Heritage List since 1982.

parts.text: UNESCO describes the property in these words: “The atoll is comprised of four large coral islands which enclose a shallow lagoon; the group of islands is itself surrounded by a coral reef. Due to difficulties of access and the atoll's isolation, Aldabra has been protected from human influence and thus retains some 152,000 giant tortoises, the world's largest population of this reptile.”
